Explore or exploit?

You have 15 nights in a new town with three restaurants. Each meal scores 0–10 at random around that restaurant's true quality. Score as many points as you can.

Let an ε-greedy agent play

The maths

The number on each restaurant is the estimated value of choosing it: the average score so far.

$$Q(a) = \frac{\text{sum of scores from } a}{N(a)}$$

$N(a)$ is how many times $a$ has been chosen. Few visits means a noisy estimate.

The greedy choice is the action with the highest estimate, written $\arg\max_a Q(a)$. An ε-greedy agent explores with probability $\varepsilon$ and is greedy otherwise:

$$A = \begin{cases} \text{random action} & \text{with probability } \varepsilon \\ \arg\max_a Q(a) & \text{with probability } 1 - \varepsilon \end{cases}$$

A random pick can also land on the greedy action. With $k$ actions, the greedy one is chosen with probability $1 - \varepsilon + \varepsilon / k$.
